sample_unit: keyword queries (one per cancer type) submitted to each of 3 chatbots

links.outcome: Readability (Coleman-Liau index) of chatbot answers on urogenital cancer treatment
links.effect: Readability was above college level: Coleman-Liau 16.9 (ChatGPT), 17.2 (Gemini), 16 (Copilot). PEMAT-P understandability was low (40%).
links.quote: Their readability according to the Coleman-Liau index was above the college level (16.9, 17.2, 16, respectively).

links.outcome: Reading level of chatbot patient-facing treatment information versus user reading level
links.effect: Coleman-Liau readability scores of 16.9, 17.2 and 16, above college level, for ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot respectively.
links.quote: Their readability according to the Coleman-Liau index was above the college level (16.9, 17.2, 16, respectively).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three LLM chatbots answering common patient queries regarding urogenital cancer treatments using standard quality and readability instruments.
